description: semanticCommits is pinned rather than left at 'auto': auto-detection infers the convention from recent commits, and a young repo gives it nothing to read.

customManagers.description: The Dockerfile's base image versions live in annotated ARGs; the dockerfile manager reads them through FROM but cannot write back, so these are updated here instead.

packageRules.description: Covered by the ARG custom manager; left on, the dockerfile manager proposes an update it cannot apply and reopens the PR after every merge.
The Dockerfile's Go version and go.mod must move together, or the image builds against a toolchain the module does not declare.
